verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, along with an Invoicing API and CLI, so a programmatic agent surface for billing exists. The pack does not show the specific operations or the permission model the story asks for, and credit notes are documented only through the Dashboard. missing for 10: evidence of creating subscriptions and changing plans via API/MCP, API-based credit application, scoped/restricted permissions for agents, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my billing — create a subscription, apply a credit, change a plan — through a programmatic surface with scoped permissions

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
Or, use the Invoicing API and advanced features to automate how you collect and reconcile payments.
Use the Dashboard to adjust or refund finalized invoices with credit notes.
